messages:
olivia: quick follow-up on the security segment from todays all-hands. a couple of procurement teams asked two concrete things: (1) can auditors be granted time-limited access to raw logs, and (2) what does our ISO evidence mapping look like vs SOC2?

 tara (Security): short answers: were designing a time-limited auditor access workflow (approved request, NDA check, short-lived credentials, strict read-only scope, and full access logging). ISO mapping is slightly different from SOC2 but well publish a control matrix. more below.

 munir: for the auditor access flow  how short-lived are the creds? are we talking a one-off download or interactive access?

 tara (Security): were supporting two modes: (A) an audited bundle export (one-off download of unredacted artifacts) and (B) interactive session with short-lived creds (1-8 hour windows) for on-site-like reviews. both require a compliance request ticket + approval. all actions are logged and retained per our retention policy.

 maria: what artifacts are in the bundle? will it include build/deploy trails and config diffs?

 tara (Security): bundle includes infra config snapshots, IAM rosters, deployment audit trails, sample request traces, and if requested, unredacted data-plane logs (only under NDA). were working with the assessor to ensure formats align with ISO/ SOC2 expectations.

 elaine (Legal): note: legal review required for any unredacted access; we need an executed DPA + auditor NDA. please route requests through compliance so we can attach the right paperwork.

 dev-platform: on the export tech: planned features are S3 export (signed link), time-limited interactive access (temporary IAM role), and an activity digest for the customer and Redwood security. sample export command for the bundle: 

```
redwood compliance export --org example-inc --scope=soc2,iso --start=2026-03-01 --end=2026-03-31 --dest s3://example-inc-audit-bundles
```

 munir: retention question: can customers ask us to retain evidence longer than our default (e.g., 3 years)?

 tara (Security): default retention for audit meta/evidence is 1 year, but were building an extended-retention add-on for enterprise customers (configurable to multiple years). will surface pricing and controls in the compliance docs.

 olivia: ISO vs SOC2: can we get a short 1-page mapping sales can include in RFP responses? customers want to know which controls are covered and where there are gaps.

 tara (Security): yes. deliverable plan: (1) one-page control matrix (SOC2 & ISO 27001 mapping), (2) evidence pack template, and (3) auditor access workflow doc. targets: draft one-pager next week, evidence pack by end of Q2.

 maria: ill own the one-pager. tagging solutions-eng for procurement phrasing.

 compliance-bot: @maria created COMP-713: "ISO/SOC2 control matrix + auditor access workflow + evidence pack template" assigned to @maria and @tara, due 2026-05-15.

 dev-platform: FYI engineering note: BYOK in EU will require an audit trail linking key import operations to the customer org and the HSM, were instrumenting that now.

 tara (Security): important risk note: interactive unredacted sessions increase blast radius; were adding mitigations: limited feature scope, mandatory approvals, and live monitoring. mitigation details will be in the workflow doc.

 olivia: excellent. can you paste the short bullets into the all-hands follow-up doc so i can include them in the summary email to customers?

 tara (Security): will post a 5-bullet summary in 45 minutes. thanks.

 munir: last ask  will the evidence bundle include timestamps and signature verifications so auditors can rely on them?

 tara (Security): yes  all artifacts will be timestamped and signed (where applicable). were adding hash chains for critical artifacts to improve tamper-evidence.

 olivia: thanks team, this helps close the loop for several renewal conversations.
